question: Does a new Outscraper account run its Free Tier without a payment method or a USD 10 deposit?
why: The terms require a payment method before the first use, the pricing explainer lists prepaid credits or a connected credit card, a staff reply of October 29, 2022 says a new account may be asked for a USD 10 deposit, especially after several accounts from one email or IP or with a disposable email, marketing pages say no credit card is required, and an independent guide of August 24, 2026 reports the free tier will not run until a card is attached. The sign-up page (a Google sign-in or an email form, with an hCaptcha check) shows no payment field in its text, and the billing gate appears at the first task, behind a sign-up. An operator step on a new account: start the first Free Tier Google Maps task and record what the billing page asks before it runs.
